subtitle: Health & Fitness · web funnel · US + DE
verdict: A tight quiz with a real plan screen, but the per-day price outshouts the 3-month charge, the card form sits above Apple Pay, and buyers get no path into the app.

items.test: Make '$38.99 every 3 months' the largest price; move '$0.43/day' under it.
